control.description: user means manual work; agent lets TaskBoard schedule and resume native agent work.

priority.description: Scheduling priority: 4 is highest and 0 is lowest.

executionRequirement.description: Required field. null inherits TaskBoard defaults; automatic selects any eligible PC; host restricts scheduling to that PC.

workspaceRequirement.description: Required workspace policy for this task. Choose one kind deliberately; TaskBoard resolves it on the selected host before starting agent work.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capability keys the selected host must advertise before agent work starts. Missing means none.

TaskBoardExecutionRequirement.description: Select one exact AgentManager host, or automatic for any ready host. Use null in task fields to inherit the TaskBoard default.

TaskBoardWorkspaceRequirement.description: task_workspace allocates an internal workspace; directory_path uses any existing absolute host directory; existing_project selects a known project, optionally with a managed worktree; repository_path checks out a repository URL; new_project_path creates a new project folder.

# task-board/task 1.12.0

TaskBoard owns this exact workflow contract. Primary domain Objects have the configured workflow root as their direct parent. Immutable prepared payloads use the same exact contract below their owning Operation; they are evidence, not primary Tasks or Runs. Apply the state, actor, reference and recovery rules from the TaskBoard specification and decision 0011. Every write uses CAS or a retained create mutation ID. Native side effects require the saved claim, exact native plan and owner outcome evidence; this data schema alone does not authorize execution.

Comments are stored once in the retained current-only conversation below the ticket. commentStore selects its historical prefix; mutable comment observations remain in the ticket snapshot.

Retention waits for the writing owner to protect source revisions of existing unfinished Runs before readiness. Storage migration never replaces workflow claims or their exact Run pins.

Missing completion intents retain their original Run, bounded repair attempts and retry date. Todo handoffs declare a concrete next step; modes are validated by the owner.

# TaskBoard Task attachment 1.0.0

Exact immutable bytes owned by one retained TaskBoard Task. A Task revision references every published attachment. The Task embeds filename, declared media type, length, hash and uploader; unsupported media is download-only.

# task-board/revision-protection 1.0.0

Current-only storage migration ledger. Exact references protect source ticket revisions of legacy unfinished primary Runs until the Run supplies its own reference or terminates. Ledgers are refreshed before owner readiness and periodically; they never alter workflow claims, Run pins or accepted operations.

# task-board/reference-page 1.0.0

Ticket-owned storage pages retain overflowing exact evidence references. Ticket revisions pin exact page revisions; each page retains every listed pin through Hive revision references. Pages do not authorize workflow transitions and are deleted with their ticket.
